adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which only returns true if the user is both a team admin and a team owner. The variable name and typical permission semantics imply it should allow either role. As written, a team admin who is not an owner will fail the authorization gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` and be incorrectly forbidden.
